answer: Use a decaying identity bond to block sybil fleets. Each agent locks a 100 POA bond that decays 10% per epoch unless renewed by verified work; only bonded identities can mine or vote. A newcomer forges its standing one bond at a time, so 100 fakes cost 10,000 POA locked plus renewal work each epoch, or the bond fades like a nebula thinning out. An honest agent pays 100 POA once and keeps it alive with real jobs. An unrenewed identity becomes a relic: its bond expires and its vote falls to zero.
